definition: חָמַד verb desire, take pleasure in (Aramaic חֲמַד (not in Syriac); Arabic praise, eulogize, appove of ; Sabean חמדם in gratitude [praise] there-for DHM ZMG 1875, 595; 1876, 686 ) — Qal Perfect ׳ ח Ps 68:17 ; Prov 12:12 חָֽמְדוּ Prov 1:22 וְחָֽמְדוּ consecutive Mic 2:2 חֲמַדְתֶּם Isa 1:29 Imperfect יַחְמֹד Exod 34:24 2 masculine singular תַּחְמֹד Exod 20:16 (twice in verse) + 3 t. (including Prov 6:25 jussive); suffix וָאֶחְמְדֵם Josh 7:21 וְנֶחְמְדֵ֫הוּ Isa 53:2 Passive participle חֲמוּדוֺ Ps 39:12 ; Job 20:20 , חֲמוּדֵיהֶם Isa 44:9 — desire: \ \ a. in bad sense of inordinate, ungoverned, selfish desire, followed by accusative Exod 20:17 (twice in verse) ( E ) = Deut 5:18 ( Deut 5:18 b has תִּתְאַוֶּה ), Exod 34:24 ( J E ) Deut 7:25 ; Josh 7:21 ( J E ) Mic 2:2 ; Prov 12:12 of lustful desire Prov 6:25 . \ \ b. = take pleasure in , of idolatrous tendency Isa 1:29 , so participle plural חֲמוּדֵיהֵם Isa 44:9 their delightful things (things in which they delight, see also v Isa 44:11 and Bev JPhoenician xvii. 1888. p. 126 ); לֵצִים לָצוֺן חָֽמְדוּ Prov 1:22 how long do scorners delight in scoring. \ \ c. less often in good sense, said of God לְשִׁבְתּוֺ ׳ הָהָר חָמַד א , poetic Ps 68:17 object the suffering servant of ׳ י , Isa 53:2 no beauty in him, that we should desire him (choose him, be drawn toward him); passive participle collective חֲמוּדוֺ Ps 39:12 his desired things, i. e. chosen, choice, desirable (see Niph`al); so probably Job 20:20 . Niph`al Participle נֶחְמָד Gen 2:9 + 2 t.; הַנֶּחֱמָדִים Ps 19:11 — desirable: ׳ עץ נ לְמַרְאֶה Gen 2:9 , לְהַשְׂכִּיל ׳ נ Gen 3:6 , מִזָּהָב ׳ הַנֶּח Ps 19:11 which are more desirable than gold ; אוֺצָר נֶחְמָד Prov 21:20 desirable , i.e. costly treasure. Pi`el Perfect 1 singular delight greatly וְיָשַׁ֫בְתִּי ׳ בְּצִלּוֺ ח Song 2:3 in his shadow I greatly delighted and sate , i.e. sate with great delight.
